pages.text: A Slaughtergleam is an Arcane Gem formed from a red-spectrum piece of $(l:arcanearchives:items/shaped_quartz)Shaped Radiant Quartz$() in an asscher cut.$(br2)When held, your attacks are considered to have one level of the Looting enchantment. If you are wielding a weapon with the Looting enchantment, its level is increased by one
instead.$(br2)To recharge a dun Slaughtergleam, activate the gem while you have a gold nugget in your inventory. The gold nugget is consumed.

$(bold)Gemcutter recipe$()$(br2)1 × arcanearchives:shaped_quartz$(br)4 × minecraft:red_dye$(br)1 × minecraft:diamond$(br)2 × minecraft:gold_ingot$(br)2 × minecraft:lapis_block$(br2)Output: 1 × arcanearchives:slaughtergleam
